notes.title: April 21st Update!
notes.notes:
Hey all!

We've added Keyboard and Graphic settings in in-game settings menu with our latest update!

Keyboard settings
There's now custom keyboard controls in the in-game settings menu! Hooray! 
With this update, we've changed everyone's settings back to default
Default keyboard layout are as below:

A button = X
B button = Z
X button = C
Y button = V
LB = A
RB = S  
LT = D
RT = F
L3 = Q
R3 = W
Menu ＝ Return/Enter
↑ ＝ Up Arrow
↓ ＝ Down Arrow
→ ＝ Right Arrow  
← ＝ Left Arrow


To change the keybindings:
[olist]
Go to "Keyboard settings" in the in-game Settings menu
Hover over the command that you want changed and press "Backspace"
Press a key that you want the command bound to
Press "F1" to confirm changes
Press "Esc" to exit the menu
[/olist]

Please to note that the game will only display Xbox button prompts

NOTE: The controller rebinding is now handled by the STEAM client! So if you want to customize your controller bindings go to Big Picture Mode>Library>Langrisser I & II>Manage Game>Controller Configuration

Graphic settings
You can now change the resolution! Choose to play in windowed mode or in full screen.

We've also removed the Unity Launcher since this is handled in-game now.

If you have any questions about any of this, please feel free to ask either on the Steam Community forums or on discord.gg/nisa :)

Best,
Daniel
